{{Quote|Look at this medal here, this isn't just some gaudy trinket, this is an Imperial Medal of Honor. I was a pilot in the Emperor's service and you don't just get one of these for flying around Tatooine pot shotting Hutt's, this is for some real work.|A retired [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]|<ref name="sony">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature:%20Medals|text=Friday Feature: Medals}}</ref>}}
The '''Medal of Honor''' was a military decoration granted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for service above and beyond the call of duty.<ref name="SWGTCG" /> The overall design of the medal resembled that of the [[Medal of the Emperor's Fist/Legends|Medal of the Emperor's Fist]].<ref name="SWG:MorEF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Medal of the Emperor's Fist}}</ref> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had a similar award named [[Alliance Medal of Honor]].<ref name="sony" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one was awarded to an Imperial-aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] alongside several Imperial supporters for eliminating an Alliance [[General/Legends|general]] aboard a Rebel-owned [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]].<ref name="SWG:CC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=heroic|Corellian Corvette}}</ref> The same year, another Imperial Medal of Honor was awarded to an Imperial [[Ace/Legends|ace]] pilot involved in the destruction of the Rebel [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Radiant Anthem]]'' in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>
